title: J6: thread mapping convention
description: Map inReplyTo to replyTo, recompute threadRootId from the replyTo chain, map topicId to topicId; never map topicId to threadRootId (JMAP Chat forbids threadRootId without replyTo). PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.13 is planned.
notes: DECIDED: MIMI inReplyTo maps to JMAP replyTo, resolved via the senderMsgId random part plus edit aliases (mimi-00 L111, L115); an unresolved reference leaves replyTo absent (legitimate per content-09). threadRootId is computed from replyTo per base §Thread Model. topicId per mimi-00 L119 and .13.4; a topic never becomes a thread. A reaction's inReplyTo becomes a Reaction, or a reply for a media reaction (mimi-00 L123). Advertise supportsThreads: true.
